## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for the user. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test` (report any skips and why)
- [ ] `npm run build`

For audio changes, include controlled listening evidence, an unchanged control, frame/rate/channel preservation and compute measurements. State which native dependencies were tested. Documentation-only changes do not need a new audio render.

## Limits and dependencies

Describe remaining limitations and any new dependency's license/provenance. Keep private audio, weights, plugin binaries, credentials, local configuration and generated jobs out of the diff.
